name: Movers

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Vault visit
services.story: Vault visit, $35 at the warehouse; a card saved for the $20 missed-visit fee; paid at the counter.

services.name: Vault visit
services.story: Vault visit, $35; nothing taken; a YES books it; paid at the counter.

services.name: Vault load-in
services.story: Vault load-in, $55, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Pack-out help
services.story: Pack-out help, $140 (up to 2½ hours); a $40 deposit now; the $100 rest at the counter.

services.name: Custom crate
services.story: A custom crate priced from Alex's photos at $90, OK'd by Sam; a card saved for the $20 fee; paid at the counter.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Household move
services.story: Household move: the in-home survey is free, nothing taken; Tomás's written estimate of $3,390; signed, with a $200 deposit; the $3,190 balance on the bill Rosie texts at delivery, before unloading.

services.name: Household move
services.story: The same move, but Sam takes the deposit and the balance his own way, like a certified check at the door; Rosie sends nothing about money.

services.name: Piano move
services.story: An upright piano move priced from photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it); a signed estimate; a 25% deposit of $160; the $480 rest on the bill at delivery.

services.name: Loading help
services.story: Loading help, 2 movers for up to 2 hours, $179 from the list; a card saved for the $89 late-cancel fee; $179 charged when Tomás texts DONE.

services.name: Single-item move
services.story: A single-item move in town, $150, paid in full when booking (Lee Storage's $75 delivery from a vault is paid the same way).

questions_before_times: From and to: the town at each end
Home size: bedrooms, plus any storage, basement or garage
Floors at each end: stairs, an elevator, a loading dock
Heavy or special items: a piano, a safe, gym gear, art
Packing: you, us, or some of each
The move date, and how flexible it is
safety_stop: someone in danger right now, a fire, a gas smell
license: always for household moves: the company's carrier authority. Moves across state lines need the federal household goods authority (a USDOT number, plus the federal mover number); moves inside one state need that state's mover permit, where its form has one
